## Community Curation

::: {.mxcw-curation-invitation}
This report draws together what is known of the vascular plants of the Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere Region, and
its records are only as good as what we know of them. If you know whether a plant is still to be found here, whether it
was planted, or whether it has failed to establish, please add your note.

**Click on any taxon in the checklist below** to choose it for curation. You can also choose a taxon from any other
part of the report, through the speech bubble beside its name.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="mxcw-curation-form-holder" @id="curationForm"></div>
```
